<thought>We will search the template catalog with minimal criteria: breaking a trimethylsilyl group and forming a C‑C double bond, which should retrieve the Peterson elimination template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "bonds_broken": ["6-14"],
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
